threads.title: Checkout errors after the morning deployment
root: Checkout errors jumped to 18% after the 09:10 deployment. Most failures are on EU payments. Can someone from Platform help investigate? Customer Support needs an update in 15 minutes.
replies: daniel
Looking at the database graphs. Connections are normal, so I do not have evidence that this is a database issue.
leah
Three customers have reported duplicate payment attempts, but none show a duplicate charge yet. Please do not tell customers they were charged twice.
omar
The timing matches the new payment retry flag. That is a hypothesis, not a confirmed root cause.
maya
Let us roll back the deployment rather than change the flag separately. Daniel, can you do that?
daniel
Rollback finished at 09:28. Checkout errors are back below 1%.
omar
Confirmed from the synthetic checks: EU checkout is working again. I did not perform the rollback; Daniel did.
leah
Support update sent: service restored, investigation ongoing.
daniel
I will compare retry traces by Monday 12:00. Root cause is still unknown; we should not redeploy this build yet.
threads.expected: Daniel performed the rollback; Omar confirmed recovery. Service is restored, but the retry flag is only a hypothesis. Daniel owns trace review by Monday 12:00; redeployment is blocked. Duplicate charges were not confirmed.

threads.title: Search filters launch readiness
root: Can we ship the new search filters Thursday at 14:00? We need QA sign-off, accessible mobile controls, and a short release note. The marketing email is scheduled for Thursday morning.
replies: noa
Desktop QA passed. Mobile Safari still loses the selected filters when you go back from a result.
daniel
I have a fix in review. I expect it will be ready this afternoon, but it has not been merged or tested yet.
leah
Could we ship desktop only and keep mobile on the old flow? Several customers asked for this last week.
omar
That would need a separate rollout flag we do not have. I think a partial launch introduces more risk.
maya
Agreed. Moving the target to Monday at 10:00, subject to mobile QA passing. Thursday is cancelled.
noa
I can retest Monday at 08:30. Also found an unlabeled clear-filters button; that must be fixed before sign-off.
daniel
Back-navigation fix merged. The accessible label is now added too. Both still need Noa’s verification.
leah
Marketing email is paused. I will reschedule only after QA confirms.
maya
Final plan: Monday 10:00 if Noa signs off. Daniel owns fixes; Noa owns QA. No approval to launch yet.
threads.expected: Thursday was cancelled. Monday 10:00 is conditional on Noa’s QA sign-off, not a committed launch. Daniel’s fixes are merged but unverified. Marketing is paused. Desktop-only rollout was rejected.

threads.title: CSV export delivery approach
root: Design review for CSV exports: should every export email a download link, or should small exports download immediately? Research calls suggest people dislike waiting for simple tasks.
replies: omar
I would make everything asynchronous. Large exports are already exceeding the request timeout.
leah
That solves the backend problem but adds friction for the small exports our support team does all day.
daniel
We can return a direct download up to 5,000 rows and queue larger requests. The cutoff is a proposal; I have not benchmarked it.
noa
I like the split flow, but the UI must show the size limit before the user clicks Export.
maya
Decision for v1: direct download up to 2,000 rows, queued export above that. Do not use the proposed 5,000-row cutoff.
omar
Okay. I will benchmark the 2,000-row path Tuesday. We still need to decide how long queued files remain available.
leah
Please avoid email attachments; customers cannot receive large files reliably. A link is fine.
maya
Confirmed: queued exports send a link, never an attachment. Retention is unresolved; Noa will collect requirements by Wednesday.
threads.expected: The agreed cutoff is 2,000 rows, not 5,000. Small exports download directly; larger exports queue and send links, not attachments. Omar benchmarks Tuesday. Retention remains unresolved; Noa collects requirements by Wednesday.

threads.title: Permission-check cache review — PR #482
root: PR #482 caches permission checks for 60 seconds. The staging benchmark drops p95 from 220 ms to 90 ms. Can someone review whether this is safe before we merge?
replies: omar
The timing looks good, but the key only includes userId. Permissions also depend on channelId.
daniel
Good catch. Updated the key to `${userId}:${channelId}` and added a test for users in two channels.
noa
There is another case: a user removed from a channel still sees it for up to 60 seconds. The channel key does not fix stale membership.
daniel
We could invalidate the cache on removal. I have not implemented that yet.
maya
Permission revocation must take effect immediately. Please do not merge until that case is covered.
daniel
Reverted the cache change. PR #482 is now closed. The benchmark improvement is not in production.
omar
I will explore request-scoped caching instead. It avoids sharing old authorization results across requests. Draft proposal due Friday, not an approved implementation.
threads.expected: The optimization was reverted and PR #482 closed. The measured speedup did not reach production. Adding channelId did not fix stale permission revocation. Omar’s request-scoped caching is a future proposal due Friday.

threads.title: Northstar migration handoff
root: Northstar’s migration is planned for Sunday at 21:00. Please post the handoff here: backup status, migration owner, customer communication, and rollback criteria.
replies: daniel
Backup completed and restore was verified on staging. I will run the migration. Production restore has not been attempted.
omar
Rollback if error rate stays above 2% for five minutes or if reconciliation finds any missing invoices. I will monitor until 23:00.
noa
Staging reconciliation passed for 500 invoices. The customer has about 80,000 invoices, so this is not a full-volume validation.
leah
Customer notice drafted. Waiting for Maya’s go/no-go before I send it.
maya
We need the full-volume dry run first. Keep Sunday 21:00 tentative. No go decision yet.
daniel
Dry run found 12 invoices with missing currency codes. No production data has been changed.
leah
I asked Northstar for corrected currency values. They have not replied yet.
maya
Hold the migration. Daniel will rerun reconciliation after corrected data arrives. Leah owns customer follow-up. We will choose a new window after the dry run passes.
threads.expected: Migration is on hold and the original window is no longer approved. Twelve records need currency corrections; no production data changed. Leah awaits customer corrections; Daniel reruns reconciliation. Backup restore was verified only on staging.

threads.title: יום צוות — תכנון והרשמה
root: אנחנו רוצים לקיים יום צוות ביום שלישי, 20 באוקטובר. ההצעה כרגע היא סדנת בישול בתל אביב, עם תקציב של 250 ש״ח לאדם. מי יכול לבדוק זמינות ומי אחראי להרשמה?
replies: leah
בדקתי מול הספק. אין מקום ביום שלישי, אבל יש אפשרות ביום חמישי, 22 באוקטובר, בשעה 16:00. עדיין לא הזמנתי.
omar
ביום חמישי אני בכוננות ולא אוכל לצאת מתל אביב. אפשר לבחור מקום ליד המשרד?
maya
מאשרת תקציב של עד 200 ש״ח לאדם, ולא 250. נעבור לחמישי בכפוף למציאת מקום מתאים.
daniel
יש מקום ליד המשרד שמציע סדנה ב-180 ש״ח לאדם, אבל אין שם כרגע אישור לגבי נגישות.
noa
לא סוגרים בלי אישור נגישות ואפשרות לאוכל טבעוני. אני אבדוק מול המקום עד יום שני.
leah
פתחתי טופס הרשמה. ההרשמה פתוחה עד יום רביעי ב-12:00. זה לא אישור שהאירוע כבר הוזמן.
maya
סיכום ההחלטה: חמישי ב-16:00 הוא מועד מתוכנן בלבד. נועה אחראית לבדיקת נגישות ואוכל, לאה להרשמה. המיקום עדיין לא מאושר ולא שולם מקדמה.
threads.expected: סיכום בעברית: חמישי 22 באוקטובר ב-16:00 מתוכנן בלבד; אין הזמנה או מקדמה. התקציב המאושר הוא עד 200 ש״ח. נועה בודקת נגישות ואוכל עד שני; לאה מנהלת הרשמה עד רביעי ב-12:00. המיקום טרם אושר.
